# NetworkConnectivity

`c.NetworkConnectivity` calls the API's NetworkConnectivity group. Whether the
host reaches an address, by ICMP ping.

## Methods

| Method                                | Returns                                                | Permission             | Description                    |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| [`Ping(ctx, hostname, input)`](#ping) | `*Response[Collection[NetworkConnectivityPingResult]]` | `connectivity:execute` | Ping an address from the host. |

### Ping

```go
func (s *NetworkConnectivityService) Ping(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
	input NetworkConnectivityPingInput,
) (*Response[Collection[NetworkConnectivityPingResult]], error)
```

Ping an address from the host.

Sends three ICMP echo requests from the host and reports how many came back, and
their round-trip times. A host that does not answer is 100% loss, not an error.
It changes nothing, so it reports changed: false. On Linux the agent pings
without root when net.ipv4.ping_group_range admits its group.

It sends `POST /api/node/{hostname}/network/connectivity/ping`, and needs the
permission `connectivity:execute`.

The examples of the method's definition:

A host that answers, `go run network_connectivity.go ping`:

```go
resp, err := c.NetworkConnectivity.Ping(ctx, target, client.NetworkConnectivityPingInput{Address: "127.0.0.1"})
```

A host that does not answer, `go run network_connectivity.go ping-2`:

```go
resp, err := c.NetworkConnectivity.Ping(ctx, target, client.NetworkConnectivityPingInput{Address: "192.0.2.1"})
```

### NetworkConnectivityPingResult

| Field             | Type      | Description                                                                                 |
| ----------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `AvgRTT`          | `string`  | Average round-trip time in milliseconds, with two decimals. Absent when no reply came back. |
| `Changed`         | `bool`    | Always false: a ping changes nothing on the host.                                           |
| `Error`           | `string`  | Error message if the agent failed.                                                          |
| `Hostname`        | `string`  | Hostname of the agent that produced this result.                                            |
| `MaxRTT`          | `string`  | Maximum round-trip time in milliseconds, with two decimals. Absent when no reply came back. |
| `MinRTT`          | `string`  | Minimum round-trip time in milliseconds, with two decimals. Absent when no reply came back. |
| `PacketLoss`      | `float64` | Percentage of packet loss.                                                                  |
| `PacketsReceived` | `int`     | Number of packets received.                                                                 |
| `PacketsSent`     | `int`     | Number of packets sent.                                                                     |
| `Status`          | `string`  | The status of the operation for this host. It is one of: ok, failed, skipped, timeout.      |
